changeinfo.changes:
Major Features Choose the way you like to play-- New difficulty settings to please Casual and Hardcore players are now in the Options Menu! XP now awarded on arena boards
Improvements Adjustments to improve game for colour-blind players Reduced Mana cost for Special Abilities -- Feel extra awesome by using your hero’s special abilities early and often! Reduced the price for Hirelings -- Grow your party for less gold! Minor menu navigation fixes Achievement for Tower Climb Arena board fixed
